query:
SELECT ?l ?item ?sl WHERE {
  VALUES ?l { "Christopher Columbus"@en "Pedro Álvares Cabral"@en "Treaty of Tordesillas"@en "Portuguese Empire"@en
   "Spanish Empire"@en "British Empire"@en "French colonial empire"@en "Dutch Empire"@en "Crown of Castile"@en
   "Colonial Brazil"@en "Empire of Brazil"@en "United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves"@en
   "Independence of Brazil"@en "Napoleon"@en "Louisiana Purchase"@en "Berlin Conference"@en "Congo Free State"@en
   "Belgian Congo"@en "Suez Crisis"@en "decolonization"@en "decolonisation of Africa"@en "Decolonization of Africa"@en
   "Decolonisation of Asia"@en "Vasco da Gama"@en "Portuguese India"@en "Annexation of Goa"@en "Ferdinand Magellan"@en }
  ?item rdfs:label ?l .
  ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sl .
}
LIMIT 200
